reasoning: On the season so far the Knicks are the stronger team; with home court the Knicks start about 7 points better, in a game of about 218 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Pacers.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Knicks win 65 times in 100, by about 5; most games like this end between 192 and 240 total points.
